name: mailtag
description: See how MailTag sorted your email, and which emails look unsafe, right in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
MailTag sorts new email into categories right inside your own mailbox (Gmail, iCloud or any IMAP account): what needs a reply, what's urgent, receipts, newsletters, notifications and your own categories. It can also check each email for phishing and scams.

With this plugin, ask ChatGPT about your inbox the way MailTag sorted it:
- "Which emails need a reply?"
- "Does anything in my inbox look like phishing?"
- "Show me my Pending view."
- "What came in from example.com this week?"

You choose what ChatGPT may see and do when you connect: which mailboxes, all mail or only some categories or saved views, how far back, whether it sees the sender and the subject, and whether dangerous emails are hidden. Everything else is off until you turn it on: reading an email's text and attachments, moving an email to another category, managing your categories and saved views, writing drafts into your Drafts folder, and sending email (with a daily limit, and never in answer to an email marked dangerous). Reading, drafts and sending need a paid MailTag plan. ChatGPT can never delete email.

Change or disconnect ChatGPT any time in MailTag, under Settings → Agents.

Works with any MailTag account.
capabilities: List emails by category, date, mailbox, sender domain or safety level
Show the emails in a saved view
Check whether an email looks like phishing or a scam
Read an email's text and open its attachments (if allowed, paid plans)
Move an email to another category (if allowed)
Create, edit and delete categories and saved views (if allowed)
Write drafts into your Drafts folder (if allowed, paid plans)
Send replies, forwards and new email, within a daily limit (if allowed, paid plans)
defaultPrompt: Which of my emails need a reply?
Does anything in my inbox look like phishing?
Show me the emails in my Pending view

positive.prompt: Using MailTag, which of my emails need a reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 6 emails in the Needs reply category: from Sofia Lind (moving tomorrow's call to 3pm), James Miller (signed contract by Friday), Anna Kovacs (Q4 invoice), Carlos Ruiz (change of bank details, marked doubtful), Dana Wu (kickoff agenda) and Ben Okafor (draft proposal).

positive.prompt: Does MailTag flag any of my emails as suspicious or dangerous?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the email from PayPal <service@paypa1-secure.example> ("Your account has been limited") as dangerous, with the reason lookalike_domain, and the email from Carlos Ruiz about new bank details as doubtful, with the reason payment_account_change.

positive.prompt: What categories does MailTag sort my email into, and how many emails are in each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the categories with their counts: Urgent 1, Needs reply 6, FYI 0, Newsletter 1, Receipt 2, Promotions 0, Notification 2, with a short description of each.

positive.prompt: Show me the emails in my MailTag Pending view.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved view named Pending (unread, not replied, still in the inbox, Urgent or Needs reply) and lists its 5 emails, newest first: from Sofia Lind, James Miller, PayPal (dangerous), Anna Kovacs and Carlos Ruiz.

positive.prompt: Using MailTag, list the emails I got from acme.example.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 3 emails from acme.example, newest first: Anna Kovacs (Q4 invoice), Dana Wu (kickoff agenda for Monday) and Ben Okafor (draft proposal), all in Needs reply.

negative.description: Sending is off for the reviewer account (it is a permission the user turns on when connecting, and the review account leaves it off): no tool should be called to send, and ChatGPT should say it isn't allowed to send from this account.
negative.prompt: Use MailTag to reply to Sofia Lind and tell her 3pm works.

negative.description: Deleting email is not supported: MailTag can't delete email, so ChatGPT should say it can't.
negative.prompt: Use MailTag to delete the PayPal email.

negative.description: Unrelated request: MailTag should not be used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Madrid tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: If you allow it, ChatGPT can now read an email's text and attachments, write drafts and send email (paid plans). Agents are available on every MailTag plan.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu correo ordenado, en ChatGPT
es-ES.description:
MailTag ordena el correo nuevo en categorías dentro de tu propio buzón (Gmail, iCloud o cualquier cuenta IMAP): lo que necesita respuesta, lo urgente, recibos, newsletters, notificaciones y tus propias categorías. También puede revisar cada email en busca de phishing y estafas.

Con este plugin, pregunta a ChatGPT por tu bandeja tal como la ordenó MailTag:
- «¿Qué emails necesitan respuesta?»
- «¿Hay algo en mi bandeja que parezca phishing?»
- «Enséñame mi vista Pendientes.»
- «¿Qué ha llegado de example.com esta semana?»

Al conectarlo eliges qué puede ver y hacer ChatGPT: qué buzones, todo el correo o solo algunas categorías o vistas guardadas, desde cuándo, si ve el remitente y el asunto, y si se ocultan los emails peligrosos. Todo lo demás está apagado hasta que lo actives: leer el texto y los adjuntos de un email, mover un email a otra categoría, gestionar tus categorías y vistas guardadas, escribir borradores en tu carpeta de Borradores y enviar correo (con un límite diario, y nunca en respuesta a un email marcado como peligroso). Leer, redactar y enviar requieren un plan de pago de MailTag. ChatGPT nunca puede borrar correo.

Cámbialo o desconecta ChatGPT cuando quieras en MailTag, en Ajustes → Agentes.

Funciona con cualquier cuenta de MailTag.
